shell.crashed: This page ran into a problem

sync.pending_other: {{size}} in {{count}} files not on Modal yet

home.title: Volumes
home.uploadingHint_one: {{count}} file is waiting to upload. Keep the Mac awake until it's done.
home.uploadingHint_other: {{count}} files are waiting to upload. Keep the Mac awake until they're done.
home.totalHint: The volumes' sizes on Modal, as last measured
home.emptyP: Add a volume from your Modal account, and modalfs puts it in a folder on this Mac.

vol.unmountPending: {{size}} isn't on Modal yet. modalfs uploads it first, then unmounts. Nothing is deleted.
vol.unmountClean: Everything is on Modal. The folder disappears from Finder; nothing is deleted.
vol.removeP: modalfs stops managing it. The volume and its files on Modal are untouched, and you can add it again any time.
vol.removeLivePending: It's unmounted first, after the {{size}} not on Modal yet is uploaded.
vol.stoppingBackground: Unmounted · uploading the rest in the background
vol.nowP: The folder goes away at once, even if apps have files open in it. What isn't on Modal yet stays on this Mac and keeps uploading in the background; if modalfs quits first, it's uploaded the next time this volume is mounted.
vol.busyTitle: Couldn't unmount: something is using it
vol.busyP: Close the files open there, then try again.
vol.forceApps: {{apps}} may show errors and lose changes they haven't saved.
vol.forceAppsUnknown: Apps with files open in it may show errors and lose changes they haven't saved.
vol.forceUploaded: Everything modalfs had is on Modal.
vol.forcePending: What isn't on Modal yet stays on this Mac and keeps uploading in the background.
vol.sizeAfterMount: Mount it once, and its size is measured.
vol.measuredHint_one: Measured {{ago}}, {{count}} file. Modal doesn't report sizes, so modalfs lists the volume.
vol.measuredHint_other: Measured {{ago}}, {{count}} files. Modal doesn't report sizes, so modalfs lists the volume.
vol.sessionHint: Uploaded since it was mounted {{ago}}, in {{commits}} uploads
vol.conflictsP: The file changed on Modal while you edited it here. Modal's version kept the name; yours is the copy next to it. Keep what you want, then mark it handled.
vol.trafficSoon: The chart starts after a minute or so.
vol.trafficLabel: Uploads and reads over the last hour, peaking at {{peak}}/s
vol.onConflict: When both sides changed a file
vol.litterHint: .DS_Store and ._ files stay on this Mac and are never uploaded.

opts.title: Mount options of {{name}}
opts.remount: It's mounted: modalfs unmounts it (after uploading), saves, and mounts it again.
opts.keepBothD: If a file changed on Modal while you edited it, yours is saved next to it as a copy.
opts.overwriteD: Your version replaces the one on Modal, even if someone changed it meanwhile.
opts.overwriteWarn: Changes made on Modal by anyone else are lost when your version is uploaded over them.
opts.modeD: Automatic uses NFS on macOS and FUSE on Linux.

addVol.title: Add a volume
addVol.desc: Pick a volume from your Modal account for modalfs to manage. It's mounted in your mount location.
addVol.none: Every volume here is already added
addVol.v1: v1 volume: modalfs mounts v2 only

dl.title: Remote downloads
dl.sub: Modal downloads straight into a volume; the Mac can sleep meanwhile.
dl.noLimitInfo: Modal doesn't tell the credit left or the spend limit; click to open its billing page
dl.emptyP: Paste a link and pick a folder in one of your volumes. Modal downloads it there.
dl.emptyNoAccount: Connect a Modal account first, in Settings.
dl.offTitle: Download in Modal, straight into a volume
dl.offP: Each download runs in a small container in your Modal account, billed to it. The Mac can sleep or be off meanwhile.

whyShort.billing: Modal: out of credit or over the spend limit
whyShort.unexplained: Modal didn't start it; check the spend limit

dl.goneLong: The server says the file isn't there. Trying again won't help: check the link.
dl.pauseHint: Stops the container and the billing; the progress is kept.
dl.resumeHint: Starts a container again: about ${{price}} an hour.
dl.deleteP: The {{size}} downloaded so far is deleted from the volume. This can't be undone.
dl.deletePause: Only want it to stop? Pause it: the progress is kept.
dl.removeDoneP: The downloaded files stay in the volume; only the record of the download goes.
dl.removeEmptyP: Nothing was downloaded, so no file is deleted.
dl.costHint: About {{time}} of running at ${{price}} an hour. Modal's bill is the exact figure.
dl.linksHint: One per line, each its own download: http, https, ftp or magnet.
dl.notALink: {{link}} isn't a link (http://, https://, ftp:// or magnet:)
dl.noVolumes: Mount a volume once, then it can be picked here.
dl.neverOverwrites: an existing file is never replaced
dl.costHint2: Billed to {{workspace}}'s Modal account by the second. It stops when the download ends or is paused.

netHint.auto: YouTube through Cloudflare WARP, as YouTube often refuses cloud servers; everything else direct.
netHint.warp: Through Cloudflare WARP, for sites that block cloud servers. Slower. If WARP can't be reached, the download stops: it never goes direct instead.
netHint.direct: Straight from Modal's network: the fastest.

dl.warpAuto_one: Goes through Cloudflare WARP (YouTube often refuses cloud servers). Slower.
dl.warpAuto_other: {{count}} links go through Cloudflare WARP (YouTube often refuses cloud servers). Slower.
dl.warpAll_other: {{count}} links go through Cloudflare WARP. Slower.
dl.torrentDirect_one: A torrent connects to its peers directly: they see the container's address.
dl.torrentDirect_other: {{count}} torrents connect to their peers directly: they see the container's address.
dl.noWarpTorrent: Torrents can't go through Cloudflare WARP: BitTorrent reaches its peers directly. Choose Automatic or Direct.
dl.warpHint: Through Cloudflare WARP: sites see Cloudflare's address, not Modal's. Slower than direct.
dl.torrentPeers: BitTorrent connects to its peers directly, so they see the container's address
dl.withoutWarpHint: Downloads straight from Modal's network. A site that blocks cloud servers, like YouTube, may refuse it.

toolHint.auto: yt-dlp for video sites, gopeed for everything else.
toolHint.gopeed: Fast, with many connections at once. On some servers it fails; then aria2 takes over by itself.
toolHint.aria2: Steady and widely used, also for BitTorrent.
toolHint.yt-dlp: For video and audio pages, such as YouTube. Updated to the latest version for each download.

downloads.sizeHint: A bigger container costs more and rarely downloads faster.
downloads.cookiesHint: For yt-dlp, a cookies.txt for sites that want a sign-in. It's sent with the download and not kept.
downloads.cookiesLoaded: {{name}} is sent with the download and not kept.

chart.hint: Point at the line for the acceleration there

downloads.recordsError: Couldn't read all of its records: {{error}}

ev.preempted: Modal stopped the container, as it sometimes does to move work around. The download continued {{gap}} later on a new one, keeping the {{done}} it had.
ev.preemptedNow: Modal stopped the container, as it sometimes does to move work around, with {{done}} saved. It continues on a new one shortly.
ev.lost: The container was lost without warning. The download continued {{gap}} later on a new one, from {{done}}.
ev.handover: Reached the Function's 24-hour limit and continued in a new one {{gap}} later.
ev.handoverNow: Reached the Function's 24-hour limit; continuing in a new one.
ev.error_one: {{tool}} reported an error, and the download was continued: {{message}}
ev.error_other: {{tool}} reported the same error {{count}} times, and the download was continued each time: {{message}}
ev.fallback: gopeed couldn't continue, so {{tool}} took over. It starts the file over.
ev.stallKick: No data for {{time}}, so the connections were opened again.
ev.stallStop: No data for {{time}}, so it stopped rather than keep the Function running for nothing.
ev.warp: Connected through Cloudflare WARP, leaving in {{colo}}

why.billing: Modal says this workspace is out of credit or has hit its spend limit, so it won't run the download. Raise the limit or add credit on Modal's Usage & Billing page, then resume it.
why.unexplained: Modal stopped this without saying why. One cause is a workspace that has hit its spend limit or run out of credit, when Modal won't start containers. Check Modal's Usage & Billing page, then try again.
why.warp: This download was to go through Cloudflare WARP, and WARP couldn't be used, so nothing was downloaded directly instead. Try again, or retry without WARP.

downloads.silent: No word from the download's container for {{time}}. Modal may still be starting or moving it. If this goes on, the workspace may have hit its spend limit or run out of credit, and Modal won't start one.
downloads.noFolders: No folders yet: the download goes at the top of the volume.
downloads.folderNew: A new folder: it's made when the download finishes.

acct.disconnectP_one: modalfs forgets the token and {{count}} volume it manages. Nothing on Modal changes.
acct.disconnectP_other: modalfs forgets the token and the {{count}} volumes it manages. Nothing on Modal changes.
acct.disconnectNone: modalfs forgets the token. Nothing on Modal changes.
acct.tokenDesc: For when the old one expired or was revoked. It must be a token of {{workspace}}.
acct.tokenSaved: Token replaced; mounted volumes use it from their next mount
acct.envDesc: Where new volumes of this account are looked up.

connect.title: Connect a Modal account
connect.desc: modalfs keeps its own copy of the token, so switching the Modal CLI's profile never moves a mount.
connect.safe: The token stays in this Mac's Keychain.

ev.follow_rename: Volume renamed {{a0}} → {{a1}}; the mount follows it
ev.stale_cleaned: Cleaned up a stale mount at {{a0}}
ev.unmounted_forced: {{a0}} was in use ({{a1}}), so it was unmounted by force
ev.unmounted_forced_noapps: {{a0}} was in use, so it was unmounted by force
ev.unmount_busy_noapps: Couldn't unmount {{a0}}: something is using it
ev.upload_left: Some changes couldn't be uploaded yet. They're kept on this computer and uploaded the next time it's mounted: {{a0}}
ev.automount_retry: Couldn't mount yet ({{a0}}); trying again in {{a1}} s
ev.quit_now: Quitting without waiting for uploads. The rest is uploaded the next time each volume is mounted
ev.service_updated: Start at login ran {{a0}}, which is gone; it now runs {{a1}}
ev.pending_kept_ro: Changes from an earlier session are kept on this computer and are uploaded the next time this volume is mounted with write access
ev.dl_preparing: Preparing the downloader in your Modal workspace (when modalfs is new or updated)
ev.dl_interrupted: Modal stopped the container downloading {{a0}}; it continues on a new one from what it saved
ev.dl_continued: {{a0}} reached the Function's 24-hour limit and continues in a new one
ev.dl_stalled: {{a0}} stopped: the server sent nothing for too long. Resume it to try again
ev.dl_time_limit: {{a0}} paused at the Function's time limit. Resume it to continue
ev.dl_failed_billing: Download of {{a0}} failed: Modal says the workspace is out of credit or over its spend limit ({{a1}})
ev.dl_failed_unexplained: Download of {{a0}} failed: Modal stopped it without saying why ({{a1}}). Check the workspace's spend limit and credit
ev.dl_stop_failed: Couldn't stop {{a0}}: {{a1}}. It may still be running in your Modal workspace
ev.dl_stopped_hard: The container downloading {{a0}} didn't answer, so it was stopped at once. Resuming continues from its last saved state

settings.title: Settings
settings.loginD: Runs in the background after you log in, so volumes set to mount at login are there without opening this window.
settings.loginMissing: It runs {{path}}, which isn't there anymore. Quit modalfs and open it again from where it is now to fix this.
settings.mountRootD: New volumes are mounted in a folder named after them inside this one.
settings.remoteDownloadsD: Each download you add runs in a container in that account's Modal workspace and is billed to it while it runs. Mounting never starts one.
settings.dlOffP_one: {{count}} download is running in Modal and is billed while it runs. Turning this off only stops new ones.
settings.dlOffP_other: {{count}} downloads are running in Modal and are billed while they run. Turning this off only stops new ones.
settings.downloadSizeD: A bigger container costs more and rarely downloads faster. Small suits most links.
settings.stallD: A server that stops sending would otherwise keep the container running, and billed, for nothing.
settings.cacheD: Blocks read from Modal, shared by every volume. Unsaved changes are kept apart and aren't counted.
settings.cacheSmall: Below {{n}} GB, read-ahead and files you reopen are often downloaded again.
settings.cacheSizeD: Any whole number of GB from {{min}}. We recommend at least {{n}} GB, and more if you read many large files at once. Unsaved writes are kept on disk separately and don't count toward this.
settings.cacheSizeBad: Enter a whole number of at least {{min}}.
settings.clearP: Blocks are downloaded again when they're next read. Unsaved changes aren't touched.
settings.readAheadD: 8 MiB blocks fetched ahead during sequential reads.
settings.transportD: Change this only behind a proxy that allows HTTP/1.1 and nothing else.
settings.quitD: Closing the window doesn't unmount anything; this does, and stops modalfs.

mounts.stalled: nothing sent in the last minute; still trying
mounts.stopBackground: Unmounted; uploading the rest in the background.

quit.title: Quitting modalfs…
quit.sub: Each volume is unmounted once its changes are on Modal.
quit.nowP: Quit now unmounts everything at once and stops uploading. Changes that aren't on Modal yet stay saved on this computer and are uploaded the next time you mount each volume.
quit.doneP: Your volumes are unmounted. Open modalfs again to mount them.

quitList.title: Quitting modalfs
quitList.sub: Each volume unmounts once its changes are on Modal.
quitList.skipped: Unmounted · the rest uploads next time

quitList.downloads_one: {{count}} remote download keeps running on Modal
quitList.downloads_other: {{count}} remote downloads keep running on Modal
quitList.quitNowHint: Unmounts everything at once and stops uploading. What isn't on Modal yet stays saved on this Mac and uploads the next time each volume is mounted; nothing is lost.

form.label: Name
form.tokenHint: Create a token at modal.com → Settings → API Tokens. The secret is kept in the Keychain.
form.volNameHint: Letters, digits, . _ and -, up to 64. Creates a v2 volume.
form.volNameBad: Use letters, digits, . _ and -, starting with a letter or digit.
form.deleteP: Every file in this volume is deleted for good. This can't be undone.

mountErr.token: Modal rejected this account's token. Replace it in Settings.
mountErr.offline: Couldn't reach Modal. Check this Mac's internet connection; modalfs tries again by itself.
mountErr.recreated: The volume was deleted, and a new one now has its name. Use the new volume if that's what you want.
mountErr.gone: This volume no longer exists on Modal.
mountErr.notEmpty: The folder isn't empty. Choose an empty folder in the mount options.
mountErr.taken: Something else is already mounted at this folder.
mountErr.fuse: macFUSE isn't installed. The automatic mode needs nothing extra.
mountErr.v1: This is a v1 volume; modalfs works with v2 volumes only.
